body:
Probed with a throwaway session (killed afterwards).

Has: named PTY sessions surviving detach; one unix socket per session in /run/user/1000/zmx/<name>; labels k=v at create or later (zmx set, and get returns them sorted); list shows name/pid/clients/created/cwd; history emits VT text including an injected ZMX_TASK_COMPLETED:<token>:$? marker; wait blocks and reports completed/failed with exit code; tail follows output; run -d dispatches; print/send/write/print-env; completions.

Does not have (as CLI surface): hierarchy or grouping, a session role or state beyond task markers, readiness/restart policy, a manifest or reconciliation, durable per-session output capture, structured/JSON output, notifications, any TUI. Labels are free-form, so any meaning is the caller's.
title: zmx 0.8.1 observed surface
